_why: Corrections to the surveyed level, each backed by the original itself: the floor probe (data/emu/floor.json) recorded Ai standing where the built level has nothing, or a course away from where it puts him. The level cannot be rebuilt here - build_level.py needs the map image, which is not in the repository - so tools/apply_level_fixes.py writes these into js/level.js. Re-apply them after any rebuild.

88.why: the probe stood at feet 72 on cells 25-29; the ledge at y 8 over cells 27-30 is a course above that and caught him first

93.why: the probe stood at feet 64 on cells 0-4 and the level has no floor there at all

149.why: the probe stood at feet 128 on cells 19-20; the floor stopped at cell 20 and he dropped through it

211.why: the room draws a floor over cells 2-13 of its bottom course and the original's object table stands two cups on it (cells 7 and 8); the probe never reached it, so the build read the whole left of the room as a pit

248.why: the probe stood at feet 64 on cell 16; the ledge was laid a course higher, so he walked above the floor
